contribution.position: My position is unchanged: reliability evidence is still incomplete. The test report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and the perf report (p99 within budget at peak) are healthy, but neither exercises retry or failure-amplification behavior. The incident log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both traced to retry storms, so that is the gap that matters. The ops turn cites a restore test (artifact:restore-test-2026-08) as proof that the rollback path works. That artifact is not among the provided evidence, and the runbook says nightly backups have never had a restore tested. Until the cited test is produced, I treat the recovery path as unproven. Two bounded items would close this: (1) a retry-storm or fault-injection result for this change, and (2) one successful restore drill from the nightly backup, or the actual restore-test record if it exists.
